data.gender_notes: Aadhil is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Just; fair; honourable; one who judges fairly
data.long_meaning: Variant spelling of Arabic ʿādil (عادل) 'just, fair, equitable', the active participle of ʿadala 'to act justly', from the root ʿ-d-l which also gives ʿadl 'justice'. Aadhil therefore means “Just; fair; honourable; one who judges fairly”. Arabic active participle ʿādil 'just, fair'; spelling variant of Aadil.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aadhil expresses “Close friend”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadhil total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

faq.q: Is Aadhil the same name as Aadil?
faq.a: Yes - Aadhil and Aadil are two English spellings of the same Arabic name عادل, meaning 'just, fair'. The -dh- is a transliteration choice for the Arabic letter ض/د sound.

faq.q: What does the name Aadhil mean?
faq.a: Aadhil means “Just; fair; honourable; one who judges fairly”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aadhil come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aadhil?
faq.a: The root of Aadhil is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: How is Aadhil written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aadhil is written عادل in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aadhil a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadhil is used as a male name.

faq.q: Does Aadhil appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aadhil is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aadhil verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Just; fair; honourable; one who judges fairly” is established by Arabic active participle ʿādil 'just, fair'; spelling variant of Aadil..
